---
title: "Analyse_Stan_Model"
format: html
embed-resources: true
---

```{r Packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(rstan)
library(tidybayes)
```

```{r Load_Model}
growthModel <- read_rds("outputs/stan_model.rds")
```

```{r summary table}
print(growthModel, 
      pars = c('a_r', 'b_temp', 'b_temp2',
               'b_conc', 'sigma_particles', 'sigma_k', 'sd_r'), 
      digits_summary = 6)

```

```{r traceplots}
traceplot(growthModel, 
          pars = c('a_r', 'b_temp', 'b_temp2',
                   'b_conc', 'sigma_particles', 'sigma_k', 'sd_r'))
```

```{r parameter_posteriors}
growthModel |>
  spread_draws(a_r, b_temp, b_temp2, b_conc,
               sigma_particles, sigma_k, sd_r) |>
  gather_variables() |>
  mutate(medval = median(.value)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = .value)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "cadetblue4") +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = medval), 
             colour = "sienna3", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "", y = "") +
  facet_wrap(facets = vars(.variable),
             scales = 'free') +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

```{r predicted_r}
growthModel |>
  spread_draws(a_r, b_temp, b_temp2) |>
  mutate(temp = 0) |>
  complete(nesting(.chain,.iteration,.draw,a_r,b_temp,b_temp2),
           temp = seq(-5, 5)) |>
  mutate(pred_r = a_r+(b_temp*temp)+(b_temp2*(temp^2))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = temp, y = pred_r)) +
  stat_lineribbon(aes(y = pred_r), 
                  .width = c(.99, .95, .8, .5), 
                  color = "#08519C") +
  scale_fill_brewer()
```

```{r predicted_k}
growthModel |>
  spread_draws(b_conc) |>
  mutate(conc = 0) |>
  complete(nesting(.chain,.iteration,.draw,b_conc),
           conc = seq(0, 0.5, by = .1)) |>
  mutate(pred_k = exp(b_conc*conc)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = conc, y = pred_k)) +
  stat_lineribbon(aes(y = pred_k), 
                  .width = c(.99, .95, .8, .5), 
                  color = "#08519C") +
  scale_fill_brewer()


```
